# 2 Baruch Chapter 23 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Second Fast and Dialogue

---

**23:1** And I answered and said: O Lord my Lord, I have spoken before you already what I knew, and I have learned what I did not know.

**23:2** For you have said previously that you know the number of those who are born — how many there shall be, how many have already come, and how many are yet to come.

**23:3** But this one thing I say before you: just as those in the womb do not know the hour of their coming forth, and those who return to the dust do not know the hour of their departure —

**23:4** So also human beings do not know the hour of your visitation.

**23:5** And I said to him: But are there indeed souls that are reserved in the treasury, so that when the number is complete they may come forth?

**23:6** And he answered and said to me: All the souls that are now alive, and those that have already departed, and those yet to be born — behold, they are all with him.

**23:7** For the Most High has not made the world except for the sake of the many; but the coming one will not come until the number that has been decreed is complete.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering. Key decisions: "treasury" (v.5) retained without gloss — the term is used plainly here and is clarified by context; "the coming one" (v.7) preserved as a messianic reference; "return to the dust" (v.3) preferred over PNEUMA's "dying" for its biblical resonance (Gen 3:19).*
